explanation: Generated 25 eta-channel points at W=1.6 GeV, Q2=1.0 GeV^2, cos(theta*)=0, with phi* uniformly spanning 0 through 345 degrees inclusive (14.375-degree spacing). All 25 points passed EXCLURAD preflight and were chunked 10/10/5. Because beam energy was not specified, the validated eta campaign default of 6.53 GeV was used; radiative corrections depend on beam energy, so this must be confirmed for the intended experiment. The channel-default vcut=0.166 GeV^2 and full O(alpha) mode were used.
